text: The UEBA system flagged this week for JAF0209 due to an unusual volume of logons outside his typical working hours and a significant increase in overall activity volume compared to same-role peers. Additionally, he made 1330 web requests, far exceeding his typical rate of 950 and even surpassing the maximum recorded activity for someone in his role.
